correctness.rationale: For char != 3, the hyperplane divisor 3O at a geometric flex identifies the nine flexes with E[3]. The distinct zero-sum triples are exactly affine lines; the identifications intertwine arithmetic Frobenius, whose linear part has determinant q mod 3 by the Weil pairing. Independent interpolation from all possible images of an affine frame, with lines constructed as distinct zero-sum triples, reproduced 432 maps, 11 classes, all ten CSV spectra and their multiplicities. The 7/3 keys are unique in their determinant classes, and a cycle of length d contributes (1-T^d)^(-1). Direct F7 arithmetic reproduced point counts 5,13,7 and division-polynomial root sets empty, {0}, {0,1,2,4}; the proof's phrase 'nonzero x-coordinates' should mean finite x-coordinates (zero is valid). Rational roots specify stable subgroups, and A-I invertible when f=1 ensures no further fixed cosets. Correct for characteristic 2 as none of the torsor/divisor argument uses char != 2. The list is for compatible actions, not field-by-field realization. Reproduction: /tmp/opencode/check_hesse_independent.py.
